suppress.notes: CVE-2026-54291 (CVSS >= 7). org.postgresql:postgresql is pinned to 42.7.11 by Spring Boot 4.0.7's dependency-management BOM ({strictly 42.7.11}) - see ADR 0002 for why this app is on Boot 4.0.7. No newer Boot patch line has been verified against this project's stack as of 2026-08-20. Forcing a driver version outside Boot's tested pairing is a real compatibility risk that needs its own verification pass, not a silent override. Scoped to the exact pinned version so this suppression stops matching the moment the driver is upgraded. Review by: 2026-11-18.

Six CVSS >= 7 findings (CVE-2026-53404, CVE-2026-53434, CVE-2026-55276, CVE-2026-59083, CVE-2026-59084, CVE-2026-66299) against the embedded Tomcat bundled by Spring Boot 4.0.7's spring-boot-tomcat starter, version 11.0.22 - also a {strictly} BOM pin, same reasoning as the postgresql suppression above: no newer Boot patch line has been verified against this project as of 2026-08-20, and overriding embedded-container versions outside Boot's tested pairing is a real compatibility risk. Scoped to the exact pinned version. Review by: 2026-11-18.
Same six CVEs as tomcat-embed-core above, same reasoning - tomcat-embed-websocket is pulled in as a sibling artifact of the same Boot-pinned Tomcat version. Review by: 2026-11-18.

CVE-2026-65898 (CVSS >= 7) in DOMPurify 3.2.4, bundled inside the Swagger UI webjar shipped by springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui 2.8.6 (swagger-ui.js / swagger-ui-bundle.js / swagger-ui-es-bundle.js all embed the same vendored copy). No springdoc-openapi release with a patched swagger-ui/DOMPurify bundle has been verified against this project's OpenAPI setup as of 2026-08-20. DOMPurify has several additional lower-severity CVEs against this bundle that don't cross the CVSS 7.0 gate and are left unsuppressed - they remain visible in the dependency-check report. Review by: 2026-11-18.
